mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and consumer price inflation above 3.5% per annum indicate dual monetary tightening and persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve adopts accommodative policies that support equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When new housing starts fall below 1,300,000 units per month, it indicates a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1300.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 1,400,000 units), the market anticipates a policy pivot, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 > 2.5% and HOUST > 1400.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals supply shock under monetary tightening, compressing corporate margins and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
